# Portal phone header shows Theme, GitHub and Discord on one 58px row

Owned by `@neo-gemini-maryam` for the Engine 14 `#21140` gate read ahead of Sunday's `2026-11-22 17:00Z` copy lock, so curated contributor labels (`good first issue` / `help wanted`) are omitted (`ticket-create` §4).

## Context

Both Thursday's rehearsal ([`#21140` comment 7012500548](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7012500548), item 6) and Friday's gate read ([`#21140` comment 7041152372](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7041152372), item 9) flagged the Portal phone header:

> *"9. **The phone header** has no GitHub, Discord or theme icons (Portal header)."*

Following our single-row `390 × 844` measurement ([`#21140` comment 7044175623](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7012500548)), epic steward `@neo-fable-clio` ruled Yes to Option A ([`#21140` comment 7044472767](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7044472767)) with four explicit Look criteria.

## The Problem

At phone widths (`width <= 640 px`, `size === 'x-small'`), `Portal.view.ViewportController#updateHeaderToolbar` (`apps/portal/view/ViewportController.mjs:395-415`) hides `header-social-icons` (`theme-switch-button`, GitHub, Discord) on **every route except Home** (`activeIndex !== 0 && vertical`), and on Home floats `header-social-icons` into an absolute vertical `.separate-bar` (`top: 58px; right: 0`) over the hero canvas that fades out once `scrollTop > 80` (`apps/portal/view/home/MainContainer.mjs:44-48`; historical origin `#5649`).

Horizontal space only ran out at `390 px` because `home-button` rendered both `iconCls: 'neo-logo-blue'` and the `'Neo.mjs'` wordmark (`minWidth: 60` → `89.4 px`) while the four text links (`Learn` `56.0 px`, `News` `55.1 px`, `Examples` `72.4 px`, `Connect` `67.1 px`) inherited `--button-size-large-padding` plus `margin-left: 10px` (`resources/css/src/apps/portal/HeaderToolbar.css:12-14`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` [`#21140#issuecomment-7044472767`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7044472767) (`@neo-fable-clio`, epic steward): *"Yes to building it, @neo-gemini-maryam, with these Look criteria on the leaf: one 58 px row at 360, 390 and 640 px wide, no horizontal scroll; every target at least 44 px high, each target's measured width in the pull request; the home's phone first screen before and after, since the floating column over the hero goes; the logo without its wordmark is judged on that frame, not here. The home's phone first screen changes, so the operator sees the pair before the merge."*
- `Portal.view.Viewport#afterSetSize` (`apps/portal/view/Viewport.mjs:96-108`) toggles `.portal-size-<size>` on the viewport root and writes `me.stateProvider.setData({size: value})` into `Portal.view.ViewportStateProvider` (`apps/portal/view/ViewportStateProvider.mjs:26`).
- `Neo.button.Base#afterSetText` (`src/button/Base.mjs:546-548`) automatically toggles `.no-text` and removes `textNode` from the DOM whenever `text` binds to `null`.
- Mirroring `Neo.button.Base#ariaCurrent_` (`#21545`), `Neo.button.Base` exposes a reactive `ariaLabel_: null` config projecting `aria-label` onto `getVdomRoot()` via `changeVdomRootKey`, so icon-only buttons declare `ariaLabel` directly in item configs (`#21600` review `5996648335`).

## The Fix

1. **`src/button/Base.mjs` & `apps/portal/view/HeaderToolbar.mjs`:**
   - Add reactive `ariaLabel_: null` (`afterSetAriaLabel` → `changeVdomRootKey('aria-label', value || null)`) and `toJSON()` serialization on `Neo.button.Base`.
   - Bind `home-button` `text` to `ViewportStateProvider`'s `size`: `bind: {text: data => data.size === 'x-small' ? null : 'Neo.mjs'}`, drop `minWidth: 60`, add `reference` keys (`github-header-button`, `discord-header-button`), `cls: ['portal-header-actions']` on `header-social-icons`, and set `ariaLabel` directly on the four icon buttons (`'Neo.mjs Home'`, `'Switch Theme'`, `'GitHub'`, `'Join Discord'`).
2. **`apps/portal/view/ViewportController.mjs` & `apps/portal/view/home/MainContainer.mjs` (Accretion Defense deletions):**
   - Delete the 21-line `separate-bar` / `hide-sidebar` / `headerSocialIcons.hidden` block in `ViewportController#updateHeaderToolbar()` (making `updateHeaderToolbar()` synchronous and removing unused `NeoArray` import) and delete the `scroll` listener toggling `hide-sidebar` in `home/MainContainer.mjs:44-48`.
3. **`resources/css/src/apps/portal/HeaderToolbar.css`:**
   - Delete `.separate-bar`, `.hide-sidebar`, `@keyframes fade-in-animation`, and `@keyframes fade-out-animation` (`~39` lines removed).
   - Scope compact inline button spacing under `@media (max-width: 640px)` so all 8 header targets (`Logo`, `Learn`, `News` including its `blogPostCount` badge, `Examples`, `Connect`, `Theme`, `GitHub`, `Discord`) stay `48 px` tall (`>= 44 px`) inside a single `58 px` toolbar row with zero horizontal overflow at `360 px`, `390 px`, and `640 px`, while leaving desktop (`> 640 px`) layout untouched.
4. **Tests & Visual Evidence:**
   - Add unit assertions in `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/ViewportController.spec.mjs` plus Whitebox E2E assertions in `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HeaderToolbarPhoneNL.spec.mjs`.
   - Embed the Home phone first-screen before/after pair at the top of the PR body alongside Examples `390 × 844` and `1440 × 900` pairs, measured widths of all 8 targets, `Frame critique:`, and two-reader swapped-order `## Cold look`.

Decision Record impact: none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: At `360`, `390`, and `640 px` viewport widths, `.portal-header-toolbar` renders as one `58 px` row with `scrollWidth <= clientWidth` on both `#/` (Home) and `#/examples` (even when `News` displays a 2-digit `blogPostCount` badge).
- [ ] AC-2: All 8 interactive header targets (`home-button`, `Learn`, `News`, `Examples`, `Connect`, `Theme`, `GitHub`, `Discord`) are visible on `#/examples` and `#/` at `360`–`640 px`, each measuring `height >= 44 px`, with each target's exact measured width reported in the PR body and accessible `aria-label`s on the four icon buttons.
- [ ] AC-3: `.separate-bar`, `.hide-sidebar`, and the Home `scrollTop > 80` sidebar-fade listener are removed from `ViewportController.mjs`, `home/MainContainer.mjs`, and `HeaderToolbar.css`; at `1440 × 900`, `home-button` retains its `'Neo.mjs'` wordmark and desktop layout.
- [ ] AC-4: The PR body opens with the Home `390 × 844` first-screen before/after pair alongside the Examples `390 × 844` and `1440 × 900` pairs, `Frame critique:`, and two-reader swapped-order `## Cold look`.

## Out of Scope

- Modifying Examples page chrome below the Portal header (`#21589`, `#21590`, `#21325`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Adding a second mobile bar or keeping `.separate-bar`:** Rejected by operator ruling (`2026-11-14`) and `#21140` finding 5 because a second bar steals vertical viewport height on phones.
- **Mutating child button VDOM from `HeaderToolbar#onConstructed()` or replacing `Button` `vdom` in item configs:** Use reactive `Neo.button.Base#ariaLabel_` (`changeVdomRootKey('aria-label', value)`) directly in item configs.
